fold_method: stratified; classes with fewer than five rows cannot enter every fold

implementation.ECE: 10 equal-mass top-label bins, stable confidence sort, weighted absolute gap
implementation.Brier: Mean per-row sum of squared errors across nine classes; not divided by 9
implementation.temperature: softmax(log(clip(p,1e-12,1))/T); one scalar T per training fold
implementation.optimiser: bounded scalar minimisation of training NLL over log(T)
